reasoning: By Mantel's theorem, every triangle-free simple graph on n vertices has at most floor(n^2/4) edges. For n=13, this is floor(169/4)=42. Equality is achieved by the complete bipartite graph K_{6,7}: partition the 13 vertices into sets of sizes 6 and 7, include every edge between the sets, and no edges within either set. It has 6·7=42 edges and is triangle-free because every bipartite graph contains no odd cycle, in particular no triangle.
